scripts.format: oxfmt --check src scripts packages vite.config.ts uno.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .vscode/extensions.json .vscode/settings.json
scripts.format:write: oxfmt --write src scripts packages vite.config.ts uno.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .vscode/extensions.json .vscode/settings.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives src scripts packages vite.config.ts uno.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives src scripts packages vite.config.ts uno.config.ts
scripts.quality: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format && bun run test
